name: JanSport
notes: Store meta: JanSport US, Denver, Colorado, USD, ships to US and CA (https://www.jansport.com/en-us/meta.json). About: 'since 1967'; 'From undyed fabrics to recycled zipper tape' (https://www.jansport.com/en-us/pages/about-us).

Free shipping on U.S. orders $50+; returns within 30 days of purchase if not damaged, altered or used; lifetime warranty: 'if your pack ever breaks down, simply return it to our warranty center.
